headline: On November 6, 1947: Meet the Press debuts on NBC
captionCards: First aired on November 6, 1947, without interruption
Still airing weekly as the longest-running U.S. television program
instagramCaption:
Meet the Press launches on NBC Television.

The longest-running American TV show debuted on November 6, 1947, with interviews and panel discussions on politics and public affairs.
It was broadcast from NBC’s studios in New York City.
A surprising detail: the show has aired weekly since its debut without interruption.
Today, it remains a key source of political analysis from Washington, D.C.
